quality.reason: No new configuration is adopted; skip adoption-only long-prefix pair. Unchanged primitive and previous short-text proofs are reused.32 raw-code greedy IDs and one peaked frontier are not general quality evidence.

validation_scope: Same original artifact and unchanged inference build;2K eager text,1,984input+32forced non-EOS greedy transitions,one in-process VMM owner,MTP/capture off.
